mapper.sql: select a.id, a.origin_id, a.status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, a.del_flag from t_out_removal a
mapper.select:
select a.id, a.origin_id, a.status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, b.code ,b.`type`,b.new_local,b.dept_name, b.create_by as maker from t_out_removal a left join t_out_delivery b on a.origin_id = b.id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = a.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
a.del_flag = '0' and a.origin_id = #{originId} and a.status = #{status}
${params.dataScope} order by a.create_time desc
mapper.delete: update t_out_removal set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

mapper.select: select a.out_delivery_id, a.material_id, a.next_flag, a.predict_count, a.predict_receive_count, a.receive_count, a.small_predict_count, a.small_receive_count, a.remark, b.code as materialCode, b.name as materialName, c.name as unitName, d.return_count, d.id from t_out_delivery_detail a left join t_material b on a.material_id = b.id left join t_unit c on b.unit_id = c.id left join t_out_removal_detail d on a.id = d.detail_origin_id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.out_delivery_id = #{deliveryId}
